A match in three moves

Turns last 45 seconds, so there's no waiting around. Most matches wrap up in about three minutes.

  1. Draw milk

    Your milk grows every turn, up to 10. It's what you spend to bring cats into play.

  2. Play cats

    Put fighters on the board and trade hits. Every cat shouts its own battle cry when it strikes.

  3. Topple the Rival

    Take the Rival Cat from 30 health down to zero and the match is yours.
